title: Twilio SendGrid API key: one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: boundary: colon instead of the dot separator between segments. Twin of "Twilio SendGrid API key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of sendgrid-token-segmented-plain: boundary: colon instead of the dot separator between segments. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
